name: The Tolling Bell (CR 11)
body:
The Tolling Bell
CR 11

XP 12,800
LE haunt
Caster Level 11th
Notice Perception DC 30 (to hear the distant sound of tolling bells)
hp 22; Trigger touch; Reset 1 hour

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, a ghostly bell appears in the belfry, tolling doom for all who hear it with an earsplitting clangor. All creatures in the belfry are targeted with a greater shout spell (save DC 22).

DESTRUCTION

The fallen, broken bell must be repaired and rehung in the belfry to lay the monks to rest.
